ttl.name: Front Shock Absorber w/ Coil Spring

s-1.ptxt: Secure Front Shock Absorber w/ Coil Spring

s2.ptxt: Install the bolt and nut to the shock absorber bracket as shown in the illustration, and secure it in a vise.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Support to Front Shock Absorber Nut

s2.ptxt: Install SST to the front coil spring LH so that the distance between the upper and lower hooks is at its widest.

atten3.ptxt: Check that the hook claws are securely engaged.

s2.ptxt: Sufficiently compress the front coil spring, and remove the front suspension support to front shock absorber nut LH.

atten3.ptxt: Do not use an impact wrench.

atten4.ptxt: The coil spring can also be removed/installed using a hydraulic spring compressor.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Suspension Support Sub-assembly LH
Remove Front Suspension Support Dust Seal LH
Remove Front Coil Spring Seat Upper LH
Remove Front Coil Spring Insulator Upper LH

s2.ptxt: Release SST and remove the front coil spring LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Coil Spring Insulator Lower LH
